name: The Desert of Singing Dunes under a Starry Sky
description: Vast, golden sand dunes shaped like frozen soundwaves, glowing softly under an incredibly dense, brilliant band of the Milky Way galaxy.
prompt: A vast desert of golden sand dunes with unique, wave-like ridges that look like frozen soundwaves or musical waves. The dunes glow with a soft, warm bioluminescence under a spectacular, crystal-clear night sky filled with a brilliant, dense band of the Milky Way galaxy. The scene feels silent yet musical, cosmic and serene. High resolution, epic landscape photography style.
caption: The quiet symphony of the desert, singing to the stars under the silent, brilliant night. 🏜️🎶
